## 1. Brand Identity & Culinary Craft
- **Business Name:** Tisdale's Southern BBQ

- **Service Model:** Mobile BBQ & Fried Seafood Food Trailer + Full-Service Event, Military, Wedding & Corporate Catering.

## 2. Signature Pit Menu & Pricing (USD)

### Smokehouse Dinners (Served with 2 Homestyle Sides & Dinner Roll)
- **Brisket Dinner ($22.00):** 100% pure hickory pellet smoked beef brisket, sliced or chopped.
- **Ribs Dinner ($18.00):** Tender hickory-smoked pork spare ribs glazed or dry-rubbed.
- **Pulled Pork Dinner ($16.00):** Slow-smoked Carolina pulled pork shoulder.
- **Smoked Turkey Leg Dinner ($22.00):** Giant festival-style hickory-smoked turkey leg.
- **Smoked Chicken Dinner ($15.00):** Half bird or leg quarters smoked over pure hickory pellets.
- **2-Meat Combo Dinner ($24.00):** Customer choice of any two smokehouse meats with two sides and roll.
